scope: Reproducible four-player simplified research model, not full Europe rules.

monte_carlo.coupling: Same world draws and per-sample opponent seeds across actions, depths and nested budgets; correct marginal distributions.
monte_carlo.arithmetic: Fraction for sampled utilities and estimates; float accumulation on identical samples is diagnostic only.
monte_carlo.budget_unit: Actual game state transitions, including root moves; excludes scoring, RNG and validation overhead.
monte_carlo.case_role: Previously observed teaching case. Repeats are algorithmic random streams, not independent game scenarios.

competition.bootstrap_unit: Whole initial-deal block; average replicates, focal seats and starting players within each deal first.
competition.seed_pairing: Opponent seat RNG seeds derive only from master, deal, starting player, replicate and seat, independent of the focal method.
competition.reuse: Reuse deterministic games and all-same-policy baseline games; reused rows are not independent observations.
competition.overlap_rule: Retain all predetermined draws; report repeated full-hand partitions and overlap with observed cases without selecting by outcomes.
competition.budget_alignment: Same initial tickets, rules, train/resource budgets and game termination. Heuristic CPU/path-query costs differ and are not claimed equal.
competition.inference: Exploratory percentile block-bootstrap intervals conditional on this synthetic deal generator and fixed map; no confirmatory significance or real-game claim.

post_result_rule: Do not tune policies or change this design after viewing evaluation outcomes. New study versions require new declared inputs.
